name: NonCommercialUseOnly
summary: The card component of Non-Commercial Use Only (DUO_0000046). It reads ProjectMembershipCredential, IntendedDataUseCredential and AgreementCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

prohibitedPurposes.description: Purpose terms, as they appear in IntendedDataUseCredential.useOnlyFor.purposes, that disqualify an IDU: an IDU is usable only if none of its purposes is in this list.
